description: Remove a planting from the garden. Siltwell archives it: it disappears from the app and from these tools, and its care schedules stop. Its harvests, events and photos stay stored, but the app has no way to restore it. Identify by plant name or plantingId. Use when the user says to delete/remove a planting (e.g. one added by mistake).

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

plant.description: Plant name of the planting to remove.

name: delete_planting
title: Archive a planting
